l4_steps.name: Extract published flight schedule for pairing input
l4_steps.input: Published SSIM flight schedule file for planning period
l4_steps.output: Validated flight activity file loaded into crew system
l4_steps.kpi: Schedule completeness ≥99.5% of planned departures loaded
l4_steps.pain_point: Schedule changes from network planning arriving <72 hrs before month close disrupt pairing optimization cycles and require costly re-runs

l4_steps.name: Load FAR Part 117 and CBA constraint parameters
l4_steps.input: FAR Part 117 regulation set, current Collective Bargaining Agreement
l4_steps.output: Legal constraint rule set activated in optimization engine
l4_steps.kpi: 100% rule compliance across all published pairings
l4_steps.pain_point: CBA rule amendments negotiated mid-planning cycle require manual rule re-entry into Jeppesen and full re-optimization, adding 8–12 hrs to the planning cycle

l4_steps.name: Validate fleet type and crew qualification matrix
l4_steps.input: Fleet assignment file, crew qualification and currency database
l4_steps.output: Qualified crew pool confirmed per aircraft type and domicile
l4_steps.kpi: Zero unqualified crew assignments at publish; qualification data currency ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Mixed-fleet type-rating transitions (e.g., 737-800 to MAX) create temporary qualification bottlenecks that reduce eligible crew pools by up to 15% during conversion windows

l4_steps.name: Generate candidate duty periods from flight activity
l4_steps.input: Validated flight activity file, crew base and domicile data
l4_steps.kpi: Generate ≥50,000 candidate pairings per iteration; generation run time <30 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Combinatorial explosion in dense network segments (e.g., 200+ daily departures from hub bases) causes candidate generation times exceeding 4 hrs, compressing the optimization window

l4_steps.name: Filter candidate pairings against FAR Part 117 limits
l4_steps.input: Candidate duty period library, FAR Part 117 duty and rest limits
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of retained pairings FAR Part 117 compliant; filter pass rate logged
l4_steps.pain_point: Augmented crew rules for ultra-long-haul operations add rule complexity that standard Jeppesen rule builds handle inconsistently without custom coding, requiring manual legal audit

l4_steps.name: Enforce crew base and domicile deadhead constraints
l4_steps.input: FAR-filtered duty periods, crew base capacity allocations
l4_steps.output: Domicile-constrained pairing set with deadhead cost estimates
l4_steps.kpi: Deadhead ratio ≤3.5% of total pairing block hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Unbalanced base staffing at thin-market domiciles forces excessive deadheading; Jeppesen does not dynamically rebalance base headcount, requiring manual planner intervention

l4_steps.name: Execute integer programming pairing optimization
l4_steps.input: Filtered pairing library, cost objective (minimize hotel, deadhead, duty cost)
l4_steps.output: Optimized pairing solution with full flight coverage
l4_steps.kpi: Pairing cost per block hour ≤$22 benchmark; solver convergence within 2 hrs
l4_steps.pain_point: Column-generation solver can converge to local optima on irregular or charter-heavy schedules, requiring manual seed pairing injection and re-run, which add 3–5 hrs to cycle time

l4_steps.name: Validate 100% flight coverage in optimized solution
l4_steps.output: Coverage validation report; list of uncovered flights if any
l4_steps.kpi: 100% flight coverage — zero uncovered departures at validation
l4_steps.pain_point: Last-minute schedule insertions post-optimization leave uncovered flights requiring manual pairing construction; no automated re-trigger exists in current Jeppesen deployment

l4_steps.name: Assess hotel and per-diem cost against budget targets
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO)
l4_steps.input: Optimized pairing plan, hotel contract rate file, CBA per-diem schedule
l4_steps.output: Crew cost estimate vs. budget variance report
l4_steps.kpi: Layover hotel cost ≤$85/night average; total pairing cost within 5% of budget
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel contract gaps at thin-market outstations force use of non-preferred vendors exceeding CBA per-diem caps; contract database in SAP not always current with Jeppesen cost model

l4_steps.name: Run CBA work rule validation on all pairings
l4_steps.input: Optimized pairing set, CBA rules library (versioned)
l4_steps.output: CBA compliance report with pass/fail per pairing
l4_steps.kpi: CBA violation rate <0.5% at initial validation run
l4_steps.pain_point: CBA rules for minimum rest, trip rig provisions, and max monthly hours are version-controlled; mismatches between Jeppesen rule builds and actual contract language cause violations that trigger formal grievances

l4_steps.name: Resolve CBA violations via manual pairing edit
l4_steps.output: Corrected pairings with no CBA violations
l4_steps.kpi: All violations resolved within 4 hrs; zero violations at final publish
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual edits to resolve CBA violations frequently create secondary coverage gaps or cost overruns, requiring iterative re-optimization loops that compress downstream rostering windows

l4_steps.name: Build crew roster lines from approved pairing set
l4_steps.input: Approved pairing set, roster period calendar, CBA day-off requirements
l4_steps.output: Draft roster lines with guaranteed time, days off, and pairing assignments
l4_steps.kpi: Average monthly guaranteed-time utilization ≥82% of CBA contractual maximum
l4_steps.pain_point: Constructing balanced roster lines that satisfy min/max flying-time guarantees across all domiciles while meeting productivity targets is highly constrained during holiday and off-peak schedule reductions

l4_steps.name: Allocate reserve crew coverage by domicile
l4_steps.input: Draft roster lines, 12-month historical disruption and sick-call rates
l4_steps.output: Reserve crew allocation plan per domicile and day type
l4_steps.kpi: Reserve coverage ratio ≥110% of projected daily sick/IRROP requirement
l4_steps.pain_point: Reserve sizing driven by IRROP scenarios requires holding excess reserves above minimum-legal levels, increasing direct crew costs by ~8%; Jeppesen reserve modelling does not natively simulate multi-day disruption cascades

l4_steps.name: Publish bid package to crew self-service portal
l4_steps.input: Finalized roster lines, reserve allocation, CBA bid lead-time requirement
l4_steps.output: Bid package published for crew seniority-based self-bidding
l4_steps.kpi: Bid package published ≥21 days before period start per CBA; 100% of lines posted
l4_steps.pain_point: Delays in schedule finalization from network planning compress bid publication windows; missing the 21-day CBA requirement triggers grievance procedures and potential arbitration costs

l4_steps.name: Process crew bids and award by seniority
l4_steps.input: Submitted crew bids, current seniority list
l4_steps.output: Awarded roster assignments per crew member
l4_steps.kpi: Bid award accuracy ≥99.9%; zero seniority inversion errors
l4_steps.pain_point: Seniority list discrepancies from SAP SuccessFactors HR integration can cause bid inversions; manual corrections require re-award runs and generate formal grievances under the CBA

l4_steps.name: Publish final rosters and sync to PSS
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen Crew Management + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Awarded bid assignments, PSS crew manifest interface
l4_steps.output: Published crew rosters; crew manifest updated in Altéa PSS
l4_steps.kpi: Roster publication ≥14 days before period start; PSS sync completed within 1 hr
l4_steps.pain_point: Roster-to-PSS sync failures cause crew check-in discrepancies at airports; bidirectional reconciliation between Jeppesen and Altéa is not fully automated, requiring manual exception clearing
